learning_objectives: Understand the concept of recursion and how it is used to solve problems
Be able to apply recursive definitions to calculate factorial values

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Recursion is only used for calculating factorial values
misconceptions.correct_concept: Recursion is a general problem-solving technique that can be applied to a wide range of problems
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are introduced to recursion through the example of calculating factorial values, and may not realize that recursion has broader applications.

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Recursion is always more efficient than iteration
misconceptions.correct_concept: Recursion and iteration can both be efficient, depending on the specific problem and implementation
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are taught that recursion is a powerful technique, and may assume that it is always the best approach without considering the trade-offs.

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Recurrence equations are only used to solve recursive problems
misconceptions.correct_concept: Recurrence equations can be used to analyze the time complexity of any algorithm, not just recursive ones
misconceptions.reason: Students may form this misconception because they are introduced to recurrence equations in the context of recursive problems, and may not realize that they have broader applications.
